title: Pilot theme
description: A friendly finance light theme: white page framed by hairlines, deep aubergine ink and dark bands, violet pills, a butter-yellow call to action, candy pink accents and pastel cyan, cream and lilac bands. Figtree with Space Mono for buttons and a handwritten script for closing lines. A deep aubergine dark sibling.
notes: secondary is the aubergine of the dark bands (header, hero, cases), not a pale surface
pastel bands are tints: accent/20 (cyan), highlight/25 (cream), glow/15 (lilac)
chart-4 (lime) and chart-5 (gold) colour the small tags and scenario labels
sets --typeface-script (La Belle Aurore); blocks read it as var(--typeface-script, cursive)
name: pilot-theme
